legal_privacy_meta_description: How {siteName} handles technical logs and, when paid generation is enabled, account and payment data.
legal_privacy_intro: This policy explains what {siteName} collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have. At launch, the gallery is free to browse and does not require an account.
legal_privacy_collect_body: When you browse, our hosting provider processes technical data such as your IP address, browser type, requested page and request time. If you use image generation, we process your prompt, reference images and generated result. To limit abuse, we retain a keyed, daily hash of your IP network prefix rather than the raw address in the generation record. If accounts or paid credits are enabled, we may also process your account email and order status. We do not currently sell personal data or use third-party advertising cookies.
legal_privacy_processors_body: The site is hosted on Cloudflare. If you choose to sign in, Google may process authentication data; if you buy credits, Waffo Pancake acts as the merchant of record and processes payment and tax data. If image generation is enabled and you submit a request, Yir and the selected model provider process your prompt and any reference images. Each provider handles data under its own terms and privacy policy.
legal_privacy_retention_body: Technical logs are kept only as long as needed for security, diagnostics and abuse prevention. For the image test, this site schedules uploaded images, prompts and results in private object storage to expire after one day; deletion is asynchronous and can take longer. Your temporary session expires after 24 hours, so download results before then. Generation records used for limits and diagnostics remain separately. Yir's policy says reference files, results and raw request data are retained for seven days, while prompts submitted on or after October 13, 2026 are retained for the life of the account; contact Yir to request deletion. Payment and tax records may be retained longer where required by law.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: The free gallery does not set advertising cookies. If image generation is enabled, an essential first-party cookie identifies your temporary session for up to 24 hours and protects access to its results. If sign-in or payments are enabled, essential cookies may keep you signed in, protect forms and remember your checkout return. We do not use these cookies to build an advertising profile.
legal_privacy_choices_body: You can ask for access to, correction of, or deletion of personal data associated with your account by emailing us. You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority where you live, to create an account or purchase credits. We may need to verify your request and may retain records that the law requires us to keep.
legal_terms_meta_description: The rules for using {siteName}'s pose reference gallery and any account-based generation service.
legal_terms_intro: These terms govern your use of {siteName}. By using the site, you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
legal_terms_service_body: The site provides a searchable collection of pose references and a limited free image generation test. Video generation and paid credits are not currently available.
legal_terms_content_body: You retain any rights you have in prompts or images you submit. You must have permission to use every upload and must not submit minors, intimate imagery, personal data you are not allowed to share, or material that infringes another person's rights. Downloads are creative references; do not redistribute the gallery as a competing stock database or imply that our brand endorses your product. The acceptable use policy contains the full content restrictions.
legal_terms_credits_body: There is currently no charge for browsing the gallery or using the limited image generation test. If paid services become available, we will disclose prices, credit quantities, usage rules and any expiry before checkout.
legal_terms_warranty_body: AI-generated reference material is provided as-is and may be inaccurate, incomplete or visually flawed. We do not guarantee that a result is unique or suitable for a particular project. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the affected service. We may update these terms and will post the new date on this page.
legal_refunds_meta_description: How refunds work if {siteName} enables paid generation and credits.
legal_refunds_intro: The launch gallery is free and does not charge you. This policy applies once paid generation is enabled, clearly priced and available for checkout.
legal_refunds_failed_body: If a generation fails, is canceled before delivery, times out, or is rejected by safety checks, the credit for that attempt is returned automatically. You do not need to contact support for a failed attempt.
legal_refunds_unused_body: Purchased credits that have never been used may be refunded within 14 calendar days of purchase. The request must cover the full unused credit lot from that order; partially used packs are not refundable. Credits obtained from a promotion or a chargeback are not refundable.
legal_refunds_ask_body: Email us with the order email, order or receipt number, purchase date and the reason for the request. We aim to respond within two business days. Waffo Pancake may show the approved refund on the original payment method within the time set by your bank.
legal_dmca_meta_description: How to report copyright infringement or counter a takedown on {siteName}.
legal_dmca_intro: We respect copyright and other intellectual-property rights. This page explains how to report a problem and how we handle repeat infringement.
legal_dmca_notice_body: Email us with your contact details, a description and URL of the material, evidence that you own or are authorized to act for the rightsholder, a statement that you have a good-faith belief the use is unauthorized, and a statement that the information is accurate under penalty of perjury. We review complete notices and may remove or disable access while we investigate.
legal_dmca_counter_body: If your material was removed and you believe the removal was mistaken, email us with the removed URL, your contact details, the reasons you have the right to use the material, and the jurisdiction and address where legal process may be served. We may share the notice with the reporting party and restore material where the law allows.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: We maintain a record of valid notices and may suspend or terminate accounts that repeatedly upload infringing material, evade enforcement, or abuse the reporting process.
legal_aup_meta_description: Content and conduct rules for {siteName}, including sexual content, violence, hate, CSAM, deepfakes and infringement.
legal_aup_intro: This policy applies to the gallery and to every prompt, upload, generation and download made through {siteName}. The rules apply even when a request is framed as art, research, role-play or a private message.
legal_aup_sexual_body: Do not create, upload or request pornography, nudity, sexual activity, sexualized poses, fetish content or other NSFW imagery.
legal_aup_violence_body: Do not create or request graphic violence, gore, mutilation, torture, instructions for harming people or animals, or content that celebrates serious harm.
legal_aup_hate_body: Do not use the service to attack, threaten, dehumanize or harass people based on protected characteristics, or to coordinate abuse against an individual or group.
legal_aup_csam_body: Child sexual abuse material is strictly prohibited. We report apparent CSAM and related conduct to the appropriate child-safety and law-enforcement channels. Do not upload, generate, request or redistribute it in any form.
legal_aup_deepfake_body: Do not use the service for face swapping, impersonation, deceptive synthetic content, non-consensual intimate imagery, or fabricated events presented as real. Do not upload a real person’s image without their permission. The current image test can change the pose of a person in an authorized photo; the output is AI-generated and must not be presented as documentary evidence.
legal_aup_ip_body: Do not use the service to copy a protected character, logo, artwork or photograph in a way that infringes copyright, trademark or other rights. Report suspected infringement through the DMCA process.
legal_aup_report_body: To report a violation, email the address below with a description and, if available, a task ID or link. Please do not attach illegal content. We review reports and may ask for further details, restrict access to the test, remove material still held by the site, or report serious violations to the relevant authorities. Every generation prompt is screened by Waffo Prompt Screening before it is processed, and only approved prompts are generated. Yir and the model provider apply their own safety policies during generation. Generated results are not automatically reviewed by this site in the current test.
legal_aup_changes_body: We may update this policy to address new risks or legal requirements. The version date on this page controls the current rules; continued use after a material update means you accept the revised policy.
